description: Returns App Store autocomplete suggestions for a search term, showing what people actually search for -- the way to check a keyword's intent is what you assume (e.g. 'rakna' autocompleting to calorie counting, not maths). Suggestion order is Apple's own ranking. Autocomplete is PREFIX completion, so a count of zero means nothing popular extends the term -- NOT that nobody searches it ('math quiz for kids' returns none and is plainly a real search). Read a low count as a prompt to look closer, never as proof a keyword is dead. This tool never spends money. It cannot buy search volume (no vendor prices a bare App Store keyword), but a suggestion that a niche_report, keyword_table or price_keywords run already bought a price for in 'us', on any of the last 7 UTC days (today counted as the first), comes back priced for free in `volumes`, carrying the day the price was bought so an older number says it is older; when none of the suggestions has such a price, a single `volume` field says why.

country.description: Two-letter App Store storefront country code, e.g. "us". Defaults to the server's configured default country.

term.description: Search term to get App Store autocomplete suggestions for.
